summary: All 7 phases of plan 01 completed. CslibTests/HvalidShapeRefutation.lean and CslibTests/BetaSplitRefutation.lean are new, module-mode, barrel-registered, fully-docstringed regression tests promoted from specs/archive/430_prove_atom_persistence_upward_closure_for_intexpan/scratch/; both build with zero warnings/info under `lake build --wfail --iofail` and are barrel-reachable via `lake test`. All 14 in-source citations in Cslib/Logics/Propositional/Tableau/ that pointed at the unresolvable scratch/-relative paths now resolve from the repository root -- 13 repointed to CslibTests/*.lean, the 14th (Scheme.lean:3474, PersistPrototype.lean) repaired to the full specs/archive/.../scratch/ path per Finding 8. All verdict text (REFUTED, PERMANENTLY DEFERRED, DISPOSITION UNDECIDED, [UNVERIFIED]) left byte-identical -- only path characters and line-wraps changed, confirmed by explicit git diff read. Phase 1's HEAD gate baseline (lake build --wfail --iofail) was wider than the plan's hypothesized 1 target: 5 pre-existing failing targets, recorded as-is per the phase's own Scope Hypothesis fallback. Phase 7's final gate re-run produced a byte-identical failing-target set (diff empty) -- no regression introduced. Subtree sorry census unchanged at 4 (same four declarations); zero new axioms; check-shake-residue.sh matches baseline (12 files); lake exe lint-style zero findings repo-wide; lake exe checkInitImports clean.
